errors.loginRefused: SolarEdge refused the login. The app tries again later.
errors.timeout: SolarEdge did not respond in time.
errors.deviceNotFound: Device not found on this site.
errors.reAddDevice: Remove and re-add this device to get kWh values.
errors.modbusProbeFailed: No compatible device answered at this address.
errors.modbusNoUnits: Nothing of this kind was found at this address.
errors.powerLimitRejected: The inverter did not accept the power limit.
errors.powerLimitUnknown: The power limit cannot be set yet: the inverter rating is not known.
errors.notSupported: This device does not support that.
errors.exportLimitOff: Export limitation is off in the inverter: the installer sets it up, with a meter.
errors.exportLimitRejected: The inverter did not accept the export limit.
errors.advancedPowerControlOff: Remote battery control needs advanced power control in the inverter (0xF142 = 1, 0xF104 = 4); ask your installer.
errors.exportLimitActive: Remote battery control does not run while export limitation is on in the inverter (SolarEdge Power Control document).
errors.backupReserveRejected: The inverter did not accept the backup reserve.
errors.noChargingSession: No charging session: plug in a car first.
errors.phaseSwitchingOff: Turn on "Phase switching via Modbus" in the device settings first.
errors.batteryMerged: No longer used: this battery is now part of the first battery device of its inverter. Please delete this device.

manual.title: Enter IP address
manual.intro: Give the device a fixed IP address in your router first, so it keeps working after a restart.
manual.modbus: Turn on Modbus TCP on the device first. It accepts only one Modbus connection at a time.
manual.notFound: Nothing found automatically: enter the address.
